scope: Mechanism development and focused closed-loop diagnosis of local command repair under the frozen mixed-airframe model; not a new independent external performance comparison
frozen: Fixed-wing/FPV/quad models, P feedback and parameters, 60s task, all archived positions, 9m/s initial velocities,2m distance,0.1s nominal and0.02s execution clocks, fixed KDE and all original metrics unchanged

repair_rule.candidate: Copy original speed-capped reference, replace selected member rows by commonb=(9,0,0); original certifier maps once and checks all3160pairs plus full common-cruise backup
repair_rule.order: First nominal. For returned limiting_pair, try each unmasked endpoint separately, ascending norm(capped_k-b), ties by global0basedindex; if both fail try both endpoints. Carry the failed both-endpoint trial's new limiting_pair into the next round. One new endpoint means one trial, no duplicate double trial.
repair_rule.reset: Mask starts empty at every20ms call; no persistent member blacklist
repair_rule.stop: Missing limiting_pair, no new member, no distinct candidate, member/round budget, or unresolved tail without a pair: stop repair and use existing retained certificate
repair_rule.duplicates: Skip a bitwise-identical previously tested candidate without recertifying; still try another distinct endpoint branch. Stop if no distinct candidate can advance the accumulated mask.
repair_rule.accept: First fully certified candidate; replace certificate and return its exact command. No remapping or post-acceptance modification.
repair_rule.not_claimed: No maximally permissive filter, optimal density tradeoff or task progress guarantee; norm determines candidate order only

same_state.extra: First recorded nominal rejection per run, if any; deduplicate within method-seed
same_state.input: Saved actual positions/velocities and saved speed_capped at that exact step; never substitute fresh feedback for held input
same_state.fallback: Do not bootstrap arbitrary historical states; original retained certificates were valid. Static checks assess new candidates without executing fallback.
checks: Old nominal success returns same accepted command bitwise
Every new accepted candidate has whole-path certificate and bitwise one-step prediction/execution match
At most16member references changed, all other mapped rows exactly preserved
All outcomes and call counts retained
same_state.closed_loop_gate: No identity/safety audit errors; all78old successes unchanged; at least one certified local candidate at the first rejection of each P seed1008/1010 with no more than16modified members. Other states, including40s, remain fully reported; they are not a selected favorable subset.

closed_loop.recompute: Fresh P from new actual state every0.1s; original model executes every accepted command. This is closed-loop, not replay.
closed_loop.reference: Compare each new run with its archived globally-replaced run on the same initial state and task
closed_loop.success: Each complete certified run must lower whole-run global-backup time, whole-run Ec/EB RMS and terminal Ec/EB relative to its archived baseline to support reduced group-level stagnation. Report density/shape and member costs separately; this does not define engineering task acceptance.
closed_loop.member_check: Record per-member repair time, longest consecutive repair, repair during40-60s, terminal world/role-coordinate target error and region status, and maximum member error. Report persistent local lag even if group means improve.
closed_loop.stop: No code/protocol changes for unfavorable outcomes. Stop affected run on consistency/safety failure or registered budget; retain all evidence. No full30-run campaign, retuning or new scenario in this phase.

measurements: Original phase windows0-15,15-40,40-60,0-60; per-seed integral-of-square RMS; native physicaldensity squaredL2 time mean; centeredshape and region separate; accepted-local fraction and calls/time additionally recorded
compute: Offline logical clocks; certificate cost may increase. No CPU delay or real-time guarantee introduced.
protected: Main manuscript, all old protocols, code and trajectories remain read-only. New implementation/records only in this directory. Fixed-wing is a required platform; a negative repair result rejects this interface candidate, not the fixed-wing research scope.
